BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. When learning Waste Water Disposal, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Waste Water Disposal.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Waste Water Disposal.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Waste Water Disposal.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Waste Water Disposal.

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. International Cricket Team

4. When learning Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.

5. When learning Building Material Schedules, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Building Material Schedules.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Material Schedules.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Material Schedules.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Material Schedules.

6. When learning Floor Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Floor Finishes.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Floor Finishes.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Floor Finishes.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Floor Finishes.

7. When learning Ceilings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ceilings.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ceilings.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Ceilings.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ceilings.

8. When learning Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Building Drawing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Drawing.

9. When learning Building Construction Project Phase 11, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Construction Project Phase 11.

10. When learning Wall Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wall Finishes.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wall Finishes.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Wall Finishes.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wall Finishes.

11. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.

12. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. CPU
   C. Monitor
   D. Speaker

13. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

14. When learning Pre-cast Concrete Products, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre-cast Concrete Products.

15. When learning Fixings and Fittings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fixings and Fittings.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Fixings and Fittings.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fixings and Fittings.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fixings and Fittings.

16. When learning Introduction to Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Building Drawing.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Floor Finishes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Ceilings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
